# Vendored QueryLens engine

The compiled `@querylens/engine` from [query-lens](https://github.com/Naveen-Boddepalli/query-lens)
(`packages/engine/dist`, query-lens commit `c2a71d8`), copied here so the profile's
"query my profile" workflow runs with no install or build step.

To update it, rebuild the engine in query-lens and copy `packages/engine/dist/**/*.js` over this folder.
